Yes, most likely. If the price dropped within 7 days of purchase, we refund the difference as Leafy store credit. Since yours dropped at 3 days, you're within that window.

Two limits apply: it's available once per item, and it doesn't cover flash sales or clearance items. If the lower price was a flash sale or clearance, it won't qualify.

If you share your order number (it looks like LF- followed by six digits) and which item dropped, I can point you to next steps. I don't have anything in the policy about how to submit the request, so I can escalate it to a Support Lead if you'd like.
